# hash-wasm 4.12.0

`sha256.umd.min.js` is copied from `hash-wasm@4.12.0/dist/sha256.umd.min.js`.
It hashes model chunks inside the worker, without allocating a complete
400 MB ArrayBuffer on the main thread. Package integrity is in package-lock.json.

Upstream: https://github.com/Daninet/hash-wasm · MIT; see LICENSE.
